name: WADI: Water Distribution Testbed Dataset
description: The WADI (Water Distribution) dataset is an industrial cyber-physical benchmark collected from a scaled physical water distribution network testbed at SUTD iTrust. Consisting of 16 days of continuous operation (14 days of normal operation and 2 days under 15 distinct cyber and physical attack scenarios) sampled every second, it monitors 127 sensor and actuator measurements (flow meters, pressure transmitters, water quality analyzers, motorized valves), providing realistic ICS attack telemetry.

publisher.name: iTrust (Singapore University of Technology and Design)
